title: The Knife in the Bed
text: This morning your steward found a knife under your heir's pillow, blade up, with another Great House's arms on the pommel. Either that is the stupidest assassin in the city, or someone very much wants you to blame that House.

options.label: Name the House on the pommel and repay them in kind.

outcomes.text: Your people return the knife to the named House the same way, under a pillow, blade up. They know you know. Whether they did it, nobody will ever say.

options.label: Put a Scion on the knife's trail to learn who truly sent it.

outcomes.text: Your Scion traces the knife to the smith who forged it, and the smith to a cellar where someone has been forging every House's arms. You burn the cellar, and the Houses are spared a war.
Your Scion follows the trail into the lower town. Two days later they are found alive in a ditch, the knife's twin in their side.

options.label: Melt the knife and say nothing; let whoever sent it wonder.

outcomes.text: The knife melts. You double the guard and keep silent. Your heir sleeps badly for a season.
